# The EMDR Coach

> A comprehensive EMDR therapy practice and professional coaching platform offering trauma-informed mental health services, clinical consultation, and business coaching for therapists.

The EMDR Coach is Dana Carretta-Stein's EMDRIA-certified practice based in Westchester, NY, providing direct EMDR therapy services, professional consultation for therapists, business coaching for private practices, and curated clinical resources for trauma healing and mental health professionals.

## Key Topics

- EMDR therapy
- Trauma-informed care
- EMDRIA certification
- Treatment planning
- Clinical consultation
- Business coaching
- Practice management
- PTSD and CPTSD
- Trauma healing
- Progress journaling
- Therapy worksheets
- Dana Carretta-Stein
- Westchester, NY
- Mental health resources
- Therapist professional development
